name: su_Pt8_SrTiO3_100
title: Pt8 / SrTiO3(001)
description: Pt8 on a frozen TiO2-terminated SrTiO3(001) slab (SrO/TiO2/SrO/TiO2, 4x4 cell, 160 atoms; NEP89 a = 3.908 A vs exp. 3.905 A), a model of Pt/SrTiO3 photocatalysts and perovskite-supported Pt. The NEP89 putative GM is a single buckled Pt8 layer (6 Pt on the surface, Pt-O 2.19 A, Pt-Ti 2.61 A; 2 Pt 1.7 A higher), in line with DFT, which finds the TiO2 termination favourable for epitaxial Pt(100) films (Asthagiri and Sholl, J. Chem. Phys. 116, 9914 (2002)). NEP89 is charge-neutral and the frozen, unreconstructed slab excludes the surface reconstructions and O vacancies of real SrTiO3(001).
